A: Game-ready 2D enemy animation for Rift Hunters. Hand-painted compact detailed pixel art, crisp square pixel clusters and selective inky violet outline. Elevated 3/4 SIDE VIEW FACING RIGHT in every frame, like the enemies in the style reference. Warm upper-left light, small dark violet lower-right rim. Family material language: off-white mineral salt crust highlights, muted dark slate and wet jade, oxidized copper, rare tiny violet light. Strong material shapes readable at 40-50px height; no smooth shading, no flat cartoon, no overbright emission. Transparent isolated sprites, no ground, no shadow, no labels, no grid lines, no frame boxes, no warning circles or scenery. Uniform equal rectangular cells and common foot baseline. Leave a generous clear gutter around EVERY sprite, including weapon and animation extremes. Constant character scale. EXACT 6 equal columns and 2 equal rows. Wide sprite sheet. The image input is a STYLE and pixel-detail reference only; draw this new character: A FLOATING manta ray made of grey green wet hide and broken oxidized copper fins, pale salt bands at its wing tips, small bright lilac gill under a narrow head, forked whip tail. Distinct broad kite silhouette. No drawn shadow. Each row is one six-frame animation in temporal order, from left to right. Gentle undulating swim in air, flapping fins; fold fins and extend its head to spit, without drawing a detached projectile, then recover. Use distinct poses, recognizable windup → action → recovery, not mirrored repeats.
